description: Zendesk provides ticketing, live chat, and knowledge-base tools that let businesses manage customer support conversations across email, chat, social, and voice channels.
auth_method: OAuth2 (authorization code / client credentials) or Basic auth with API token (being deprecated)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day free trial, no credit card, Admin Center access to generate API tokens/OAuth clients immediately
api_surface: Broad REST API (Ticketing/Support, Help Center, Chat/Talk/Sell), no official GraphQL; no official MCP server, only community ones
blocker: None for core Support API on trial; MCP is community-only

description: Intercom is a customer messaging and support platform combining live chat, help desk ticketing, and the Fin AI agent.
auth_method: OAuth2 (public apps) or personal access token (private apps)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day cardless trial, no permanent free tier so paid plan needed after trial
api_surface: REST API only (v2.15), covers conversations/contacts/companies/articles; official MCP server at mcp.intercom.com/mcp (mostly read-only, US-hosted only)
blocker: No permanent free tier; official MCP is US-only and mostly read-only

description: Freshdesk (Freshworks) is a cloud helpdesk providing ticketing, automation, and omnichannel support.
auth_method: Basic auth using API key as username
self_serve: paid plan required - free Sprout plan exists but API/integration access excluded, unlocked from Growth/Blossom tier
api_surface: REST API v2, no GraphQL; no confirmed official MCP server (EAP only), community MCP servers exist
blocker: API gated behind paid plan; no official MCP yet

description: Front is a customer operations platform unifying email, chat, SMS, social messages into shared team inboxes.
auth_method: API key (Bearer, single-workspace) or OAuth2 (public/partner integrations)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day free trial, no card required, API tokens self-generated
api_surface: REST Core API (conversations, messages, contacts, tags); official hosted MCP server (mcp.frontapp.com, OAuth2.1+PKCE, open beta)
blocker: None significant; higher rate limits are paid add-on

description: Pylon is a support platform for B2B SaaS companies combining shared inboxes, ticketing, and account intelligence.
auth_method: API key (Bearer) for REST; OAuth for MCP
self_serve: paid plan required - no free plan, starts $59/seat/mo with 3-seat minimum
api_surface: REST API (issues, accounts, contacts, teams); official hosted MCP server (mcp.usepylon.com)
blocker: No free self-serve signup, paid seats required

description: LiveAgent (QualityUnit) is a help desk combining ticketing, live chat, call center, and social media support.
auth_method: API key (apikey header) or OAuth2 access token; MCP supports Bearer token or OAuth2.1+PKCE
self_serve: self-serve trial - 30-day free trial, no card, API included in every paid tier
api_surface: REST API (tickets, contacts, agents, companies), official SDKs; official built-in MCP server

description: Plain is a support tool with a GraphQL API built for software companies to manage customer conversations and tickets.
auth_method: API key (workspace-issued, bearer token on GraphQL API)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 7-day free trial, no card, no permanent free tier (from $35/seat/mo after)
api_surface: GraphQL API only (threads, customers, tenants, help center); official first-party MCP server at mcp.plain.com/mcp (~30 tools)
blocker: No permanent free tier; GraphQL-only requires more integration work

description: Help Scout provides shared-inbox email support, live chat, and a self-serve knowledge base (Docs) product.
auth_method: OAuth2 (Mailbox API v2) or per-user API key (Docs API)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 15-day free trial, no card, API included on Standard tier
api_surface: REST API (Mailbox/Inbox API 2.0, Docs API); official GA MCP server (mcp-beta.helpscout.net) plus community servers

description: Gorgias is a helpdesk built for ecommerce brands with deep Shopify/BigCommerce/Magento integrations.
auth_method: Basic auth (private apps: email + API key) or OAuth2 Bearer (public/marketplace apps)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 7-day free trial, no card, cheapest paid Starter plan $10/mo
api_surface: REST API (tickets, customers, tags, teams); official first-party MCP server (open beta, free on every Helpdesk plan)
blocker: None major; only public marketplace apps need OAuth review

description: Gladly is an AI-powered customer service platform unifying voice, chat, email, SMS, and social channels into one customer timeline.
auth_method: API key (Bearer/Basic-style, tied to a user with API User role)
self_serve: contact-sales gated - no public self-serve signup or pricing page, ~$180+/agent/mo, 10-agent minimum, admin must provision API User role
api_surface: REST API (conversations, customers, tasks, webhooks) plus App Platform/SDK; no official or credible community MCP server found
blocker: No self-serve account creation; enterprise sales required before any API access
